_comment: Perk adapter: Hemomancy - Blood Magic 2.0.2. Its perks ask EPMagic_SpellHasKeyword Kata_BloodMagicPower
or Kata_BloodMagicPowerConc (either one; Blood Pressure +10/25/50%, Blood Cloting, Blood Pact, Blood
Spheres, Sanguine Mortis). hemomancy.esp puts them only on its own 15 spells' effects.
Not given: the Kata_BloodCost* keywords. They sit on the hidden effect that takes health instead of
magicka on Hemomancy's own spells, and the cost perks ask them; other blood spells pay their own cost.
Hemomancy counts its own Drain Health absorb as a blood spell, so vampiric drains (blood tag) get it too.
Known overlap: the Bloodskal Blade's swing spells carry KIT's blood element and get it as well.
